title: Gold-set measurement — v1.0
description: The result of measuring what the pipeline proposed against a human gold set, for one cluster. plan.md §13 item 13, chainlink #26. Machine-emitted at ci/results/gold_set/<cluster>.json by `pipeline.py measure-gold-set`; no review block, for the same reason a C_static report carries none -- it is a computation over artifacts on disk, and a human editing the score would be editing the audit. The number this artifact exists for is `omission`: gold-set edges that NO candidate source proposed at all. Precision and recall are about the proposals that were made; omission is about the ones nobody made, and it is what makes 'R2 passed, therefore I is complete' unreadable. Every measurement carries `sources[]` with each candidate source's availability, because an omission count is only interpretable next to how many independent sources were actually consulted: 3 omissions with two sources available is a different statement from 3 omissions with eight.

gold_set_review.description: Copied from the gold set that was measured against, so a measurement names the human whose judgement it scores against and when -- an audit against an anonymous standard is not an audit.

scope.description: Carried through from the gold set's curation_scope. Every count below is restricted to edges whose caller concept is in examined_concepts; a proposal outside that scope is neither right nor wrong here, because nobody looked.

sources.description: plan.md §5.2's own list of independent candidate sources, every one of them, each with its real status here. A source that does not exist yet is recorded as such rather than contributing silently nothing -- otherwise 'no source proposed this edge' would quietly mean 'the one source we built did not propose it'.

proposed_edges.description: Edges the INTERACTION SET proposes within scope -- the artifact under audit, not the union of candidate sources.

false_positives.description: Proposed by I, not in the gold set. NOT the same as R1's 'realized call absent from I' (chainlink #24, gate-r1-g16), which runs the other direction entirely -- the two are kept apart in this schema, in the report, and in the code.

omitted.description: Gold edges proposed by NO source -- not by I, not by any available independent source. The metric the other two are kept honest by.

missed_but_proposed.description: Gold edges absent from I that an independent source DID propose: the signal existed and the pipeline did not use it. A different failure from omission, and a more fixable one.

ratio.description: `undefined` rather than 1.0 or 0.0 when the denominator is zero. A pipeline that proposed nothing has not achieved perfect precision, and reporting 1.0 there is the vacuous-pass shape chainlink #48 removed from every validator in this codebase.

edge_list.description: Listed, not just counted: a number tells a reviewer how bad it is, and the edges tell them what to do.

proposed_by.description: Which sources proposed this edge. Empty for an omitted edge -- that emptiness is the finding.

rationale.description: For a gold edge, the curator's own reason, carried through so an omission is actionable without opening the gold set.

source.description: plan.md §5.2's list, plus the interaction set itself (which is the artifact under audit and is NOT independent -- it is listed so a reader can see it was not counted as corroboration).

status.description: `not-built`: no tooling exists in this codebase yet. `not-applicable-to-track`: real elsewhere but not for this track (Mode P source extraction in a greenfield workspace). `empty`: the source exists and produced nothing, which is a result, not an absence.

independent.description: Whether this source is independent of the interaction set being audited. Only independent sources count toward corroboration; the interaction set corroborating itself is the circularity this whole issue exists to measure.
